physical_acceptance_workflow: Open the canonical RayMe web URL from the physical test device and confirm Settings still names the canonical AI backend and qwen3_1_7b.
In Voice Lab, save or select the intended real-person Qwen reference only after confirming the data steward, authorization basis, LAN test scope, matching transcript, and retention/deletion terms.
Assign that saved voice to the call character; do not judge likeness using the generated non-person fallback named in this handoff.
Start the physical call and confirm Listening is visible before speaking.
Speak a normal first turn and confirm audible playback starts while the assistant is still generating, not after whole-response synthesis completes.
Interrupt a later response while audio is playing; confirm playback stops promptly, the interrupted response is not persisted as complete speech, and the call visibly returns to Listening.
Complete at least three user-to-AI turns after recovery, including one longer reply, and confirm speech remains intelligible and the selected voice remains stable.
End the call, return to the durable thread, and confirm call start/end plus completed user and assistant speech rows are present without a completed row for the cancelled response.
Start one reconnect call with the same saved voice and confirm model resident, prompt ready, early playback, and listening recovery still hold.
Record integrated listening and physical-call results separately; do not change either status to pass unless a person performed the corresponding check.
